visual: Coherent subjects and motion without severe visual defects.
prompt: Required visible subjects, actions and ordering match each frozen prompt within five requested seconds.
audio: Required sound is present and appropriate; required speech is intelligible and English-only; inspect audiovisual synchronization.
method: Watch each original twice at normal speed, blinded to mode and price. Record visual, prompt and audio judgments independently.

contracts.video_only: Pass visual and prompt requirements; ignore sound requirements while retaining all incurred costs.
contracts.audiovisual: Pass visual, prompt and audio requirements.

timing: No interactive latency acceptance gate; continuous finite requests with observed activity and all failures retained.
